description: This file defines the final class RegistrationResult, which extends RequestResponseResult<JsonObject>. It serves as a container for the result returned by Hono's registration API, providing multiple static factory methods to create instances with various combinations of status codes, payloads (as JsonObject or String), cache directives, and application properties.

classes.name: RegistrationResult
classes.description: A final class extending RequestResponseResult<JsonObject>, encapsulating the result of Hono's registration API with static factory methods for creation.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory methods to create RegistrationResult instances with various parameters: status only, status with payload (JsonObject or String), status with payload and cache directive, and status with payload, cache directive, and application properties.
